ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake Sacred Marks
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Sacred devotional wall-marks, one per Salvation god, built on mandrake.rm.graffiti's RM_BaseGraffiti filth infrastructure.
Repointed 2026-08-31 (GRAFFITI_FRAMEWORK_BUILD_1) from Mlie.GraffitiMod's own BaseGraffiti, now that mod is retired and its vandal-spree mechanic absorbed into mandrake.rm.graffiti's own C# (RM_PaintGraffitiJob/RM_PaintGraffitiJoy/ the RM_GraffitiPaintingSpreeBreak mental break). These marks are standalone ThingDefs (ParentName RM_BaseGraffiti, reusing its filth/building fields) - real, valid, game-ready content - but nothing yet spawns them automatically outside a ritual outcome. Placement (a ThingSetMaker, a bridge script) beyond that is the deferred piece; see GRAFFITI_MOD_EXPANSION_1 for the full assessment.
Shipped: RM_SacredMark_Ishko (a pair of glowing orange eyes in the dark - Ishko the Unmaskable's canon iconography, design/Jawa/divine_satiation_engine.md pantheon section). Positive Beauty, unlike GraffitiMod's uniformly-ugly filth - devotional art, not vandalism.
Placement mechanism (owner's ruling): a sacred mark is placed as a RITUAL OUTCOME - a reward off a Salvation Matrix boon - not a Harmony patch on GraffitiMod's own spawn loop and not hand-placement. RitualOutcomeEffectWorker_PlaceSacredMark (Source/SacredGraffiti.cs) is a generic, god-agnostic mechanism: on a favorable ritual outcome it spawns a sacred-mark ThingDef at the ritual site, reusing vanilla's own filthDefToSpawn/filthCountToSpawn RitualOutcomeEffectDef fields for their documented purpose (the same fields DestroyConsumableBuilding_Pyre uses to spawn Filth_Ash). Defs/RitualOutcomeEffects.xml demonstrates the parameterization for Ishko; it is not wired to any real ritual because none exist yet - the Salvation Matrix's nine gods' boons/curses are design prose only (divine_satiation_engine.md, "the engine build ... files when the owner calls the build"). This mechanism is ready the moment a real Matrix ritual exists to reference it.
Designed, not yet arted: eight sibling marks, one per remaining Salvation god, same recipe (ParentName RM_BaseGraffiti + new texPath + new statBases) - see the item file for each god's canon iconography anchor.
